question: Does the same 1697 work restate the night-Zi/Hai controversy inside its actual natal-fate (祿命) chapter, and explicitly connect the disputed Hai treatment to erroneous birth Bazi?

source.author: 陳雯
source.commons_file: File:Harvard drs 52822721 三才發秘天部二卷 v.8.pdf
source.filename_scope_note: The Commons filename retains a generic 天部二卷 label, but the physical internal title on PDF p8 directly controls this object as 三才發秘人部卷一, followed by 祿命.

r1_opening_window.result: Target directly located at p8-p10; no negative inference from other pages.

direct_physical_collation.p9_context: The 祿命 discussion defines time through solar position and proceeds through calendrical/stem-branch construction before the day/Zi boundary discussion.
p10_decisive_sequences: 子時前四刻尚屬去日交後四刻方屬今日
故夜半前之四刻乃是子時並非亥時
若立支幹當立明日子時枝幹
半夜之前卻有半個子時
時人亦不知又作為亥論
故在夜生者所生八字多有差謬

adjudication.same_work_AU_tianbu: Reports that contemporary practitioners 往往以夜子作亥 and apply it to 尅擇祿命, while rejecting that practice.
adjudication.same_work_AV_renbu_luming: Inside the dedicated 祿命 chapter, expressly states the pre-midnight four ke are Zi and not Hai, reports that people nevertheless 作為亥論, and directly attributes many night-born Bazi errors to that treatment.
adjudication.combined_result: The historical dispute is not merely mentioned from outside natal practice; it is internally operationalized and criticized inside the same work's natal-fate section.
adjudication.independence_rule: AU and AV are separate internal contexts of one 1697 work, not two independent textual lineages and not two majority votes.
adjudication.fullbook_relation: This strengthens evidence that upper/night-Zi-to-Hai was a real historical competing shushu operation. It still does not prove direct genealogy or exact identity with Fullbook 十刻/上五刻 mechanics.

next_gate: Move beyond same-work corroboration and seek an earlier or textually independent physical witness for 子亥互訛 / 夜子作亥, with 1593/1594 張果星宗 edition routes now a priority.
Continue the independent unresolved Fullbook cloudy/rain current-time acquisition chain.
Do not select a runtime winner until provenance, chronology, mechanics and school scope justify adjudication.
